text: Once you have a safety plan, keep it somewhere easy to reach and practise using it and contacting a trusted person at a calm time. Review it with the professional when things change. In immediate danger, do not rely on it alone: stay with them and call emergency services.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance, and the card is made with the child.
